Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride

Reno, NV · West Reno · Road

Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride is a road group ride in Reno, NV. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm. Pace: b ~18 mph, C ~15 mph, faster riders self-organize.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride group ride

The club's Wednesday evening ride out to Verdi with B and C groups behind ride leaders. Groups ride out together in a double paceline at talking pace and regroup three times, but don't necessarily wait on the way back. The club notes the slower groups are not slow.
